title: Watch: Diego Moreira puts Milan 3-1 up against Inter with amazing free-kick
text:
Watch: Diego Moreira puts Milan 3-1 up against Inter with amazing free-kick Scores News Favourites Home Football Predictions Premier League Daily News Roundups Promotions NFL NBA Golf Horse Racing Cricket Darts Watch: Diego Moreira puts Milan 3-1 up against Inter with amazing free-kick
 Oliver Fisher SempreMilan Oliver Fisher AC Milan took a 3-1 lead into the break in the derby, as Diego Moreira scored a wonderful goal to re-establish the lead.
 Just two minutes before the break, Milan restored their two-goal advantage thanks to a quite simply beautiful free-kick from Diego Moreira.
 After getting two assists to his name already on the night, he turned scorer with a fantastic attempt that was up and over the wall, dipping just enough to land inside the near right post.
